channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Derrick White | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Derrick White from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Derrick White
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Nick Nurse:

“(VJ) kind of came out of the halftime saying I got (Derrick) White and I'm gonna do better on him because White was cooking. I think White might have had 2 points in the 3rd quarter...and a lot of that was VJ”

Nick Nurse on Derrick White, May 2, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Zarren on Jaylen Brown, Derrick White
item.description:
Boston Celtics assistant GM Mike Zarren on the Jaylen Brown and Derrick White trade rumors:

“Those two guys are really, really great players and there hasn’t been anything close to seriously trading them. Im not sure where all that reporting came from.”

Mike Zarren on Jaylen Brown, Derrick White, Jun 26, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Nash on Derrick White
item.description:
James told Steve Nash on the Mind the Game podcast.

“Unranked in high school, zero D1 scholarship offers, played three years of Division Two basketball at UCCS, transferred to Colorado and now an NBA champion. That guy is Derrick White.”

Steve Nash on Derrick White, Jun 24, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Micah Shrewsberry on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White
item.description:
“The Jrue Holiday and Derrick White (trades), I’m like, those are Brad guys right there,”

Micah Shrewsberry on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White, May 5, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Gary Harris on Kristaps Porzingis, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Derrick White
item.description:
veteran guard Gary Harris told the Sentinel after practice Tuesday.

“Understanding [we need to] take out some of those 3s from Derrick White and [Payton] Pritchard. They hit some bigs 3s. “I know we did a good job on [Jayson] Tatum, [Jaylen] Brown and [Kristaps] Porzingis for the most part but [we need to] continue to just fly around, scramble and take away those 3s because those 3s were hurting us, especially after the turnovers in transition.”

Gary Harris on Kristaps Porzingis, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Derrick White, Apr 22, 2025. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Jamahl Mosley on Derrick White, Payton Pritchard, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Mason Williams:Jamahl Mosley on the #Magic’s defense against Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown:

“I think we did a very good job on those guys. Made it tough on them, made it difficult for them to get easy shots. For the most part, it was the Derrick White’s .. the Payton Pritchard’s… two guys you don’t really account for coming up with 49 points. I think we’ve got to do a better job there.”

Jamahl Mosley on Derrick White, Payton Pritchard, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Apr 20, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: George King on Derrick White
item.description:
King told Andscape on April 5 before practice.

“I was in Lebanon at a restaurant and Derrick was on TV, and I taped myself watching him saying, ‘Yo, you are a global superstar all in Lebanon at this restaurant.’ He was doing some community event, kissing babies.”

George King on Derrick White, Apr 8, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Dave Cowens on Derrick White
item.description:
Derrick White is one of Cowens’s favorites.

“I was so impressed with White that second year he was here,”

Dave Cowens on Derrick White, Apr 6, 2025. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Derrick White
item.description:
“D-White has never got a tech since he’s been in the league. I don’t know if anybody’s ever seen the reference in ‘The Longest Yard’ and when they was doing the recruiting and Chris Rock was like, ‘Man, I got half a star.’So I told D-White like, you gotta get one tech and get your street cred up. So I got excited when I thought he got a tech. I kind of campaigned for him to get one, one day. So we’ll see.”

Jayson Tatum on Derrick White, Apr 5, 2025. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Luke Kornet on Derrick White
item.description:
Jay King:Luke Kornet on why he and Derrick White block shots:

“He and I both know a thing or two about rejection in our lives.”

Luke Kornet on Derrick White, Dec 3, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Derrick White
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“I called Derrick right away. Just to make sure there's no confusion, my love for you and all of that. He knew that. Me and D-White are good.”

Jaylen Brown on Derrick White, Jul 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Derrick White
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on not making Team USA:

“I wasn’t surprised, but my reaction was that I was happy for D White. It’s dope to have so much of our guys on there, so I was happy for those guys. But I wasn’t surprised.”

Jaylen Brown on Derrick White, Jul 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Grant Hill on Derrick White
item.description:
USA managing director Grant Hill checked with White late Tuesday to see if he was available to replace Leonard, and told the media Wednesday night:

“When we asked, (White) had to ask (his wife).“He had to make plans and coordinate things before he could get back to us with a definite yes,”

Grant Hill on Derrick White, Jul 13, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Paul George on Derrick White, Bronny James
item.description:
Paul George on Bronny James:

“What's most impressive is just his basketball savviness. He can do it all. I feel like he hasn't shown that he can really be elite at a lot of things, but I think he can be elite at a lot of things. I compare him to the Jrue Holidays, the Derrick Whites—guys that are glue guys that can go do everything on the floor and help you. That's kind of how I see him.”

Paul George on Derrick White, Bronny James, Jun 19, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Derrick White
item.description:
“If you go back and look in the first half, Sam (Hauser) had a bunch of great looks, (Derrick White) had some looks that didn’t go down. Butwe didn’t panic. We kept guarding, we stayed in the game and we kept trusting it and we made enough tonight to win the game.”

Jaylen Brown on Derrick White, Jun 10, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Derrick White, PJ Washington
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Derrick White's block on PJ Washington:

“It looked like a foul, but it wasn't called so it wasn't a foul.”

Jason Kidd on Derrick White, PJ Washington, Jun 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Derrick White
item.description:
Brown on the chase down block with White:

“Derrick has been all-defensive all season long ... we made a tough rim read, rim reads lead to transition. We have to manage that better ... I was able to sprint back and make a play (with White).”

Jaylen Brown on Derrick White, Jun 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Bronny James on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White, Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Bronny James:

“Guys like Davion Mitchell, Jrue Holiday, and Derrick White who excel in their role, get good money and get good playing time from it because they’re locked into that role and know what they’re supposed to do.”

Bronny James on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White, Davion Mitchell, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Reece Beekman on TJ McConnell, Derrick White
item.description:
Reece Beekman:

“I like guys like Derrick White. He’s pretty good. I think TJ McConnell for the Pacers, he’s a pesky guard who gets in the lane, makes plays on offense, and defense just picks it up full court. Just making it hard on the other teams’ guys. Just trying to learn different stuff from them so I can use this offseason.”

Reece Beekman on TJ McConnell, Derrick White, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Derrick White
item.description:
Bickerstaff on Derrick White:

“It’s the confidence … a lot of (NBA players) are similarly talented … a lot of shots he’s taking and making, you wouldn’t recommend guys take… he knows being this much of a threat, it opens it up for everybody else.”

JB Bickerstaff on Derrick White, May 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Derrick White
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“Derrick White has grown. This is a new version that we haven’t seen before.”

Jaylen Brown on Derrick White, May 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Derrick White
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Derrick White:

“He’s one of the most underrated players in the leaguebecause he does it on both ends.”

Erik Spoelstra on Derrick White, Apr 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Derrick White
item.description:
Mazzulla:

“I thought we kept a level of poise ... getting to our spacing ... we come out of a timeout, Derrick hits a three, Al hits a three.”

Joe Mazzulla on Derrick White, Apr 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Derrick White
item.description:
Brad Stevens:

“Derrick's having an amazing year. Derrick's a huge, huge part of our team, and we want him around for as long as we can keep him around.”

Brad Stevens on Derrick White, Apr 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Derrick White
item.description:
Gregg Popovich on Derrick White sitting out lol:

“He’s afraid of us. … We were going to destroy him, so he sat out.”

Gregg Popovich on Derrick White, Jan 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Derrick White
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Gregg Popovich on Derrick White:

“I couldn’t be more proud of a player. When he first came, I don’t think he believed he belonged in the NBA and to watch him develop…has just been a thrill to watch. He is one of the greatest guys ever. And his confidence has just exploded.”

Gregg Popovich on Derrick White, Dec 31, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Derrick White
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on his halftime talk with Derrick White before he went off in the second half:

“I just laughed with him and we both agreed it was probably the worst half of his career.”

Joe Mazzulla on Derrick White, Dec 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Derrick White
item.description:
Souichi Terada:Tom Thibodeau:

“I think Derrick White is one of the most underrated players in the league.”

Tom Thibodeau on Derrick White, Dec 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Derrick White
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on whether Derrick White is expected to miss just one game for personal reasons:

“I’m not sure. It’s for personal reasons. I think we’ll reassess it just kind of day to day and just kind of see where he’s at.”

Joe Mazzulla on Derrick White, Nov 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Derrick White
item.description:
“We’ve talked about sacrifice looks different, but for Derrick to play with that type of feeling of empowerment, everybody has to be able to do that,”

Joe Mazzulla on Derrick White, Oct 28, 2023. Source: The Athletic.
